Air.name: Air
Air.summary: A Dreamcast port of the Japanese visual novel AIR, which adds voices to all characters minus the protagonist.

Blue Stinger.name: Blue Stinger
Blue Stinger.summary: Awakening shipwrecked just after a meteor collides with a remote biotech research island, you begin to discover an uncontrollable madness unleashed in the meteor's wake. As one secret uncovers another, you piece together a horrifying revelation that could lead to the end of life on Earth.
